art:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent 2D game sprite atlas, LAST SPURT run cycle.
Input image 1: existing normal-run Chocobo atlas as character identity, painterly art style, anatomy, gait phase and grid reference.
Create a NEW sibling last-spurt motion atlas matching the reference character and rendering: expressive cute but athletic golden-yellow Chocobo, detailed layered painted feathers with dark brown fine outlines, green eyes, orange curved beak, orange near bare lower leg and shaded brown far lower leg, ivory claws. ALL eight birds face RIGHT in the same slightly elevated side view.
Primary request: sprint all out, LOWER THE NECK AND HEAD, stretching the neck forward nearly horizontal, head ahead of chest, a focused serious expression with a narrowed green eye under a sloping feather brow, beak closed. BOTH wings spread like GLIDING wings, held swept backward nearly horizontal in an aerodynamic stable pose, visible layered long flight feathers extending toward the tail. Near wing is clearly unfurled with separated long feather tips, not folded into a round nub. Far wing visible above/behind the back. Still RUNNING ON TWO LEGS, not flying. Crest swept backward along the low head. Keep head shape recognizable, no monster or angry teeth.
Composition: EXACTLY 8 individual fully visible frames, 4 columns x 2 rows, equal square cells on 1792x896 canvas. Each sprite fits WITH transparent margins inside its own cell, no touching neighbor or cell border. Each bird has same chest position and scale, feet aligned to same common ground baseline. Keep existing two-foot cycle: frame 1 far dark foot forward contact; 2 far foot under body bearing weight with near leg tucked forward; 3 far foot pushing backward near leg extending forward; 4 airborne near leg forward far leg back; 5 near bright foot forward contact; 6 near foot under body bearing weight far leg tucked forward; 7 near foot pushing backward far leg extending forward; 8 airborne far leg forward near leg back. Every feathered thigh connected to its OWN lower leg. Strong distinct alternating foot poses, only subtle body bounce and wing flex, constant wing spread and low neck posture.
Genuine transparent alpha background. No ground, shadows, motion lines, speed effects, checkerboard paint, text, numbers, labels, frames, watermark. One bird per cell, no extra anatomy. Match reference painterly illustration quality. This is an addition to the supplied normal gait, not a replacement.
semanticMask:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: registered semantic region mask for transparent sprite atlas.
Edit target image 1: new eight-frame low-neck last-spurt Chocobo atlas.
Convert ONLY the colors to a flat semantic mask, keeping EXACTLY the same canvas dimensions (1774x887 if that's the input), all eight silhouettes, every pose, feather contours, placement, and transparent alpha. Do not redraw, enlarge, shrink, move or simplify the birds.
Color EVERY regular body feather solid CYAN #00ffff, including head/cheek/brow/neck, torso, both spread backward gliding wings, tail, belly, and BOTH upper feathered thighs.
Color ONLY the separate forehead crest plume solid MAGENTA #ff00ff. The crest is the distinct group of backward swept pointed feathers on the TOP of the lowered head, ahead of neck, above the eye, as in the input. Include all its pointed feather tips but NOT cheek, neck, brows or eye. Do this in all eight frames.
Color beak, eyes, both bare lower legs, toes and claws solid WHITE #ffffff.
No shading, no outlines in a different color, no colored background, no text, no labels, no borders. Actual transparency outside the exact original bird silhouettes. Flat high saturation classification colors. Registration must be exact so this mask can be applied pixelwise to the original atlas.
metallic:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: metallic gold material variant of transparent last-spurt 2D sprite atlas.
Edit target: supplied eight-frame low-neck last-spurt Chocobo sheet. Change ONLY body plumage material, NOT motion or anatomy.
Make body feathers noticeably polished METALLIC GOLD with selective crisp pale ivory-white gold reflection bands on extended wing feathers and tail, rich yellow-gold surfaces, deep amber-bronze shadows, coherent highlights in every frame. Preserve organic layered feather shapes and dark outlines, not armor, not plastic, not orange washed feathers. Body head/cheek/neck/chest/wings/back/belly/tail and both feathered thighs receive metallic gold. The forehead crest remains original soft yellow because it is an independent layer.
Invariants: EXACT same 1774x887 canvas, transparency, 4x2 grid, all eight poses, low neck and head, narrowed serious GREEN eye, closed orange beak, backward gliding wing spread, feather tips, chest placement, exact feathered thigh connections and orange near / brown far bare legs and ivory claws. No changes to silhouettes, location, geometry, frame order. Every foot must stay in its current position. Keep the crest, eye, beak, lower legs, feet, claws unmodified. Reflection placement follows surfaces without random glitter flickering.
True transparent alpha background. No new objects, text, numbers, scene, particles, sparkle, ground, drop shadows or glow. Registered material-only variant of finalized motion.
